resolvedStack: React Native / Expo SDK 52 + Expo Router + TypeScript + AsyncStorage
name: PulseFit Habit & Workout
description: PulseFit Habit & Workout is an offline-first Expo React Native mobile fitness companion for logging strength and cardio workouts, tracking daily wellness habits, viewing weekly streak metrics, and storing all data locally via AsyncStorage.

metadata.name: PulseFit Habit & Workout
metadata.description: Offline-first Expo SDK 52 mobile app for workout logging, daily habits, and streak analytics.

files.description: Expo SDK 52, expo-router, react-native-web, react-native-safe-area-context, @expo/vector-icons, and @react-native-async-storage/async-storage configuration.
Expo configuration with Metro web bundler, expo-router plugin, and scheme.
TypeScript configuration extending expo/tsconfig.base with @/* path alias.
Semantic design tokens for PulseFit mobile UI.
Expo Router Web HTML document shell.
Expo Router root Stack layout wrapped in SafeAreaProvider with web Live Edit inspector installer.
Expo Router bottom tab navigator layout for index, workouts, habits, and profile.

Shared TypeScript types: WorkoutCategory ('STRENGTH' | 'CARDIO' | 'MOBILITY'), WorkoutSession { id, title, category, durationMin, calories, completed, loggedAt }, HabitItem { id, title, targetPerWeek, completedDays, streak, active }.

Offline-first hook/store using @react-native-async-storage/async-storage (getItem/setItem) with realistic seeded WorkoutSession[] and HabitItem[], exporting BOTH named useFitnessStore and default export, with addWorkout, toggleWorkoutCompleted, toggleHabitToday, addHabit, resetDemoData, and computed totals.
Reusable React Native card component rendering WorkoutSession details, category badge, duration/calories, and completion toggle, exported BOTH named and default.

Today dashboard screen wrapped in SafeAreaView and ScrollView with KPI summary cards (Weekly Workouts, Total Calories, Active Habits), daily goal progress card, recent WorkoutCard items, and navigation actions via expo-router.
Workouts log screen with category filter chips (ALL, STRENGTH, CARDIO, MOBILITY), WorkoutCard list with Pressable toggle, and quick form/modal to log a new workout.
Daily habits tracker screen showing streaks, Pressable check-in buttons per habit, and an input form to create a new habit.
Athlete profile & offline storage settings screen showing total sessions, streak summary, and a Pressable button to reset demo data.
